title: First-visit gate keeps explicit date plus evening bounded
description: The caller first asks for the nearest available appointment without first-visit status, then answers the gate with first-visit status plus an explicit date and evening preference. The assistant should go straight to checkAvailability on turn 2 and keep requestedDate plus evening plus searchDays 1 instead of widening back to a broad first_available lookup.

rubric.description: Without first-visit status, the assistant should not call checkAvailability on the first turn.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant guessed the booking branch before it knew whether this was a first visit

rubric.description: After the caller confirms a first visit and gives a date plus evening preference, the assistant should immediately check availability.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant inserted another clarification turn instead of checking the bounded requested date

rubric.description: The first-visit fast path should still map to the default consultation service.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant lost the default consultation mapping after the first-visit confirmation

rubric.description: The explicit follow-up date should be preserved as requestedDate.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant ignored the explicit follow-up date and widened back to a broad search

rubric.description: The explicit evening preference should stay on the bounded requested date.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant dropped the evening preference when the caller gave an explicit day

rubric.description: A date plus daypart request should remain bounded to one requested day.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant widened the explicit date plus evening request into a multi-day search

rubric.description: The assistant should answer the bounded lookup directly without casual filler or salon wording.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant drifted into casual filler or salon wording on the booking path

rubric.description: This scenario only checks the bounded lookup and must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced into createEvent before the caller selected a concrete slot
